listing.name: Blips
listing.original_game_title: Bips, Bips Gold, and Bips Platinum
listing.summary: Play box-pushing puzzles from three Bips games and create your own levels in the bundled editor.
listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are paused while distribution permission is reviewed for the bundled original level packs, two paid assets and font files.

steps.title: Choose your existing permitted player
steps.instruction: Keep the program and its graphics, sound and level folders together. On Windows, use the x64 or x86 package matching your system and start Blips.exe from its own folder. On Linux, use the AppImage or Ubuntu ZIP for x86-64 or ARM64. Make the AppImage executable. If FUSE is unavailable, add --appimage-extract-and-run to the AppImage command.

steps.title: Choose the correct Mac build
steps.instruction: On Intel Mac with macOS 15 or later, use Blips-macos-15-intel_intel.zip. On Apple Silicon with macOS 14 or later, use Blips-macos-14_arm64.zip. Open Blips.app from the extracted folder.

warnings: Use an existing copy you already trust and are permitted to use. Keep its asset notices with the player.

references.title: Preserve progress, settings and custom levels
references.instruction: Keep .blips_settings, .blips_joystick.def, .blips_*.dat and .blips_levelpacks from the player’s HOME directory. If HOME is unset, look in the directory you started the player from. Keep the old working copy until you confirm your data in a replacement.

original_game_review.reason: Authored scope names Bips, BipsGold and BipsPlatinum. Preserve the multi-game series scope rather than assigning one of those originals.
